title: Enter the Lattice
briefing: The Lattice hums beneath the Abyssal Rifts. Cross into its resonant biome and clear the sentinels that guard the crystal fields.
fieldGuide: Late-campaign exploration milestone in the Lattice biome.

objectives.label: Enter the Lattice
objectives.detail: Step into the resonant biome where the crystal fields grow dense.

objectives.label: Cull Lattice Sentinels
objectives.detail: Destroy the guardians patrolling the crystal fields.

rewards.label: Lattice Crystal
rewards.detail: Resonant crystals salvaged from the fields.

rewards.label: Abyssal Stone
rewards.detail: Dense stone useful for deep outposts.

completionText: The Lattice has accepted your presence, and its sentinels have been silenced. The crystals are yours to study.
